learning_outcomes.title: Translations of quadratics
learning_outcomes.statement: Write a quadratic in vertex form and transform its graph.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: In y=a(x−h)²+k, the vertex is (h,k). x−h shifts right; x+h shifts left.
